info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Syndicated Loan Details API
info.description: The Syndicated Loan Details API provides users with access to specific information about syndicated loans. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed records, including terms, conditions, and borrower information for a given loan identifier. It is designed for financial institutions and developers working in banking, enabling them to integrate loan data into their applications seamlessly. Typical consumers include loan officers, risk managers, and financial analysts who require accurate loan documentation to make informed decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific syndicated loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific syndicated loan using its unique identifier. Utilize this API to access relevant data regarding the loan, including its terms, participants, and current status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about a specific syndicated loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure all required fields are included in the request to receive the accurate loan details.
